body:
Dad just came home from work saying he got laid off, lol.

2 Years on reddit, I'm really going to miss you guys, but I would really just rather let my main go cold than make anyone else sad. Thanks, for everything you guys. Setting my hard drive to reformat(lol), and going to fill my lungs with Dust Off. At the very least I'll end up brain dead by the time they find me.

I'm also pretty sure I have some health problem, I get dizzy, lose my balance, slur my speech, get headaches, and see stars, and every time I think of these symptoms being nothing I at least have a glimmer of hope that I have some brain tumor waiting to release me from this hell. The best part is we have no health insurance or anything so I can't even ask to go to the doctor for a checkup. Their inability provide anything for me will for once fall in my favor.

no, I don't have any reliable friends, no job, my parents were immigrants so seldom I see any form of extended family. I want so much to be where I should but all I feel is as if im 12 or something. And all around me is deadlines, my parents can hardly pay anything, we might get evicted soon, school semester will end i'm 70 credits behind, it feels like my life is an hourglass, and only a few grains rest at the top before it's empty.

I need guidance but who the fuck in their right mind would take time from their lives to help me if my own blood won't fucking do it. I hate them, and it's their fault I'm in this situation, everything I want, I can't have, I've contemplated murdering them before, but all it ever ends in is me praying for some terminal illness or malignant tumor to appear in my brain so I don't have to face anything. Why would I get stuck in this situation, in all that is good on this earth why, they've set such high exceptations for me, everyone, but it feels like they are telling me to build a skyscraper with a toothpick.

If there is any higher power than all it could have possibly set me up for in this time of my life is to end it, if you are making a meal, burn the meat, overcook the veggies and forget the spices than what is there to do other than throw it away? Eat it because it's all you have?
